messages.subject: [Ipmpack-users] Problem with createMPMPmatrix
messages.body_plain:
Hello everybody!

I'm having problems with the createMPMPmatrix function. Apparently it
doesn't consider the NA's in the sizeNext column, so there isn't any
mortality in the P matrix (the transition probabilities in each class add
to 1).

Am I missing something?

Greetings to everybody

Sebasti?n Palmas
School of Forest Resources and Conservation
University of Florida
